text: No, there was no detectable tree-cover loss on this asset after 2020. The analysis, using high-resolution satellite data (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020), confirmed no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger occurred between 2021 and 2025. The asset retained its tree cover throughout this period, with no changes above the detection threshold (30-meter pixels). The assessment covers the entire asset boundary and is based on annual observations up to 2025. Small or edge changes (under 0.5 ha or narrower than 30 m) may have been missed.
